main_text.p: שְׁעִבּוּרָא, שִׁעְבּוּד Ch. Subjectio, servitus, Exo. 3.7. & 4.31. ܫܥܒܕܐ Syr. Idem, 1. ad Timoth. 2. 11. & 3. 4. ad Tit. 1.6.
שעבן שַׁעְבֵּין Ch. Testes, testiculi, Gen. 39.1. in Jon.
שעה Ithpah. אִשְׁתָּעִי Chald. ܐܬܬܥܝ Syr. Narrare, Enarrare, enumerare, recensere, eloqui: Item ex usu Hebr. Nugari, ludere, oblectare se, 1. ad Cor. 10.7.
שׁוּעִית, שׁוּעָיָא, שׁוּעִי Ch. Narratio, enarratio, recitatio, Judic. 7.15. Meditatio, Colloquium, Loquela, 1. Reg. 18.27. Prov. 3.32. Dicterium, Deuteron. 28.37. Vide supra in שׁוּת.
אִשְׁתָּעוּרִי Ch. Idem, Levit. 16.6.20. in Jonath.
ܐܬܬܥܠܐ Syr. Narrationes, Historiae, Ibid. Luc. 1.1. & ad Tit. 3.9.
ܫܥܐ Syr. Fabula, Tremel. In Regiis, Scurrilitas, ad Ephes. 5.4.

שַׁעְתָּא, שַׁעְרָא Ch. & Syr. Hora, quasi Temporis nunciatrix: בְּשַׁעְתָּא Quasi horâ, momento, Subito, Num. 16.22. Psalm. 73.19. ܒܗܕܐ ܫܥܬܐ In illa ipsa hora, protinus: ܩܕܡ ܫܥܬܐ Eo momento. Pl. שְׁעָתָא, שַׁעֲיָא,
אַבֶן שָׁעָיָא Lapis horarum, id est, Gnomon horologii, Jesa. 38.8. & ex forma foeminina שַׁעְיָה ibid. Ex forma constructa est שְׁעֵי, ultimâ radicali in mutatâ in י, Genes. 28.10. in T.H.

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldee and Syriac script in this page is only approximated; several vocalised forms and Syriac words are uncertain and should be checked against the scan. The final line of the page carries a small Hebrew catchword-like mark at the foot right, not transcribed as text.
